title: Public Creator Handle Read HTTP and Runtime Boundary
summary: Expose the SESH-041 public creator handle resolution operation through a narrow anonymous GET-only HTTP boundary and SESH_DB-only runtime composition.
invariants: The route is server rendered and GET only.
The handle comes only from the dynamic route parameter.
The public HTTP boundary performs no authentication or session resolution.
The runtime uses SESH_DB only and does not require RIVER_IDENTITY_DB.
The runtime composes the canonical D1 creator handle reservation and creator profile repositories.
The operation remains responsible for normalization, canonical reservation resolution, creator profile lookup, identity consistency, and public field minimization.
Successful responses expose only handle, displayName, and optional bio.
Responses are JSON with cache-control no-store.
No public handle availability oracle is introduced.

No SeshCreatorId, PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, persistence metadata, project rights, collaboration rights, publishing rights, management rights, legal rights, or copyright rights are exposed or inferred.
This step does not create a public vanity page, handle release, or handle rename behavior.
